polityNote: Burma from its separation from British India (1 April 1937; before that its townships are drawn by BRI-provinces-1886.json) through the Union of Burma (1948), the Socialist Republic (1974) and Myanmar (1989) to 2019. Atoms: geoBoundaries ADM3 of MMR (2019 townships, Myanmar Analytics Project, CC BY 4.0), the set BRI-provinces-1886.json uses for Burma. A unit is the union of today’s townships whose lines carried the historical line; where a historical line runs through a township, or a township’s membership is not established, it is withheld (unresolved). Replaces the earlier Natural Earth dossier (1974–2019), whose Mandalay atom could not separate Nay Pyi Taw. ① The Arakan Division of 1948–74 (Rakhine with Paletwa) measures 42,973 km² against 41,442 km² in the division table statoids reproduces from Webster’s Geographical Dictionary (1957; ratio 1.04); every 1974–2019 unit is a union of the same townships the Myanmar Analytics Project assigns to that state or region (geoBoundaries ADM1, same publisher, so this is a consistency check only).
